verdict.rationale: Nix's own docs say it can skip source builds by pulling pre-built binaries from a binary cache, and a community user reports builds being shared across devs and CI. That covers the fast-install core of the story. No CI-specific cache-restore guide or offline install mode is documented; the closest item, transfer of environments between computers, is only adjacent. Missing for 10: documented CI cache-restore setup, documented offline-capable installs, independent CI speed benchmarks.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can make CI installs fast with a documented cache-restore setup and offline-capable installs

citations.quote: Nix can automatically skip building from source and instead use a binary cache, a web server that provides pre-built binaries.
Transparent build caching using binary caches
Everything is only built once, on a large set of specialized remote builders, then shared among all of our devs, CI, and deployment infrastructure.
